Players Committee card image of [[Kylo Ren With Lightsaber (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Kylo's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force, if total destiny > defense value; otherwise you lose 1 Force).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/kylorenwithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
